Canvas Commands and History
|-- [M] MappingDocumentController: shared boundary for live edits and isolated proposals
|   |-- Exposes versioned commands, native gesture commits, snapshots and subscriptions
|   |-- Calls diagram revision services for content; keeps staged dispatch private
|   |-- Delegates checkpoint, saved-view and transfer operations to CanvasHistoryService
|   |   `-- Default service hides CanvasHistory behind an editing-context handle
|   `-- [O] Runtime isolation and retention
|       |-- Controller retains its snapshot, context handle and optional live editor driver
|       |   `-- One attached driver at a time; attachment and subscription return cleanup functions
|       |-- Service WeakMap keys by handle object, even when persisted contextIds match
|       |   `-- Handles are not serialized; unreachable handles permit history collection
|       `-- History retains checkpoints and revisions; clearing redo does not delete the archive
|-- [C] Apply a command batch: applyUpdate / transact
|   |-- 1. Settle any pending live gesture, then check expected controller snapshot version
|   |   `-- Stale version or invalid batch size -> reject before staging this batch
|   |-- 2. Clone document/view and execute operations in supplied order
|   |   |-- Later operations see earlier staged changes without advancing the live head
|   |   |-- Content edits call revision services and track proven node correspondence
|   |   |-- Placement changes use grid layout: anchor changed subtree, push collisions right
|   |   |   `-- Check final bounds and overlap before committing positions
|   |   |-- Connections: remove edges with deleted placements; rebase proven endpoints
|   |   |   `-- Unchanged text/structure can prove positional correspondence; otherwise keep stale
|   |   `-- Installing diagram context checks expected diagram revision, owner and source fingerprint
|   |-- 3. Reconcile selection, links and views; validate scene; append through history service
|   |   |-- CanvasHistory validates document and revision dependencies, then installs checkpoint K
|   |   |   `-- Previous head -> past; K -> head; future cleared; active recording gains a step
|   |   `-- Controller publishes snapshot/version/history flags and notifies subscribers
|   |-- Failure during staging -> no checkpoint for this batch
|   |   `-- Diagram revision services may already have issued revisions; this is not global rollback
|   `-- Native commitEditorGesture shares staging and commits layout/selection consequences together
|       `-- Empty operation list takes the view-only path; unchanged state can return without a checkpoint
|-- [D] Exact restoration depends on checkpoint K, not the newest diagram content
|   |-- K.document supplies composition and semantic canvas metadata
|   |   |-- Placement hierarchy, positions, links, sections and presentation
|   |   `-- Also retains diagram-context bindings, alternatives and revision selections/reviews
|   |-- K.diagramBindings maps content IDs to exact diagram revision IDs
|   |   |-- History revision table supplies immutable diagram values; composition embeds none
|   |   `-- Alternatives, reviews and selections pin additional revisions
|   |       `-- Retain required ancestry subject to recorded revision boundaries
|   |-- K.view supplies personal view state separately from composition and content
|   `-- Restoring a canonical content-node endpoint needs placement + bound revision + logical node ref
|       |-- Revision.nodeRefs resolves the current content-node ID for that exact revision
|       `-- Already-unresolved legacy endpoint -> preserve its stale identity
|-- Revisiting state: navigation, saved views and proposals have different effects
|   |-- [C] Undo / redo moves the head between existing checkpoints
|   |   |-- Live controller delegates to editorDriver; restoreEditorCheckpoint navigates domain history
|   |   |-- Headless controller calls service.navigate directly
|   |   `-- Validate target, restore document and personal view, publish without appending an edit
|   |-- Named CanvasViews pin endpoints; recording also retains a checkpoint sequence
|   |   |-- [O] Names and recording metadata live outside the state restored by undo
|   |   |-- Open a different saved view -> stash working copy, restore target as a fresh checkpoint
|   |   |   `-- Preserve current camera and strip the original transfer transaction link
|   |   `-- Fork/alternatives pin children to a saved endpoint; keep/discard archive affected branches
|   |-- forkContext -> new context and baseline with empty undo/redo stacks
|   |   `-- Retains the exported archive; isolation does not mean discarding pinned history
|   `-- Generation handoff uses a saved endpoint or explicitly pinned CanvasHistoryRecord
|       |-- Completed proposed history can update a candidate's saved endpoint without moving live head
|       |-- Comparison reads pinned baseline/final endpoints without navigating history
|       `-- Separate adopt(proposed) validates and installs the proposed state as one new checkpoint
|-- [C] Cross-canvas transfer prepares a coordinated change
|   |-- prepareCanvasTransfer works on isolated source/destination histories
|   |   |-- Copy creates new identities and copies edges internal to the selected placements
|   |   `-- Move preserves identities where possible, remaps collisions, converts source edges to jumps
|   |       `-- Remove selected source placements and place the destination group
|   |-- Returns PreparedCanvasTransfer with states and transaction before/after checkpoint IDs
|   |   `-- Workspace transaction owns publication; destination checkpoint is linked, source too for move
|   `-- Transfer-linked undo/redo must go through the workspace
|       |-- Both heads must match the recorded boundary; newer edits in either canvas block navigation
|       `-- Prepare destination navigation and, for move, source navigation together
`-- Storage handoff: persistenceChanges(since)
    |-- Returns current navigation/saved-view header plus checkpoint and diagram-revision additions
    |-- Sequence selects accumulated changes; CanvasCheckpointEncoder supplies storage records
    `-- Storage consumer performs I/O; this boundary produces records
